repo.description:
### Impact

The `git:auth` command creates `$DOKKU_ROOT/.netrc` using bash's touch command, which applies the default umask of `0644`. This pre-creation defeats the `netrc` binary's built-in `0600` permission setting, leaving git credentials readable by any local user who can traverse the dokku home directory.

This security issue applies to any Dokku installation where the `git:auth` command is used to manage the netrc file and can be exploited by other users with local access to the Dokku host.

### Patches

- https://github.com/dokku/dokku/pull/8589

### Workarounds

- Run `chmod 0600 /home/dokku/.netrc` manually after any execution of the `git:auth` command
repo.summary: Git Credentials in .netrc Stored World-Readable Due to Premature touch
